back: Shareholders can lose only the amount invested in (or unpaid on) their shares; personal possessions are safe.
Shares with voting rights and a variable dividend paid after the preference dividend; they carry the most risk.
Shares with a fixed-rate dividend paid before ordinary dividends; usually no votes; repaid first on winding up.
Long-term loans to a company at a fixed rate of interest, repayable on a set date; a non-current liability.
Authorised = maximum allowed; issued = shares given out; called up = amount requested; paid up = amount received.
Issued share capital + reserves (general reserve + retained earnings).
Dividends: to owners, appropriation, deducted from retained earnings. Debenture interest: to lenders, expense (finance cost).
Number of preference shares × nominal value × fixed rate.
Retained profit transferred and kept for the long term; part of equity, not a sum of cash.
